description: Use this when asked "what should I do next?" or "give me the next working idea". Works out the product’s stage (pass `stage`, or it is read from the plan); with no project, pass `product_url` and the site is checked first so what it already does is skipped; then returns the three best next steps for that stage, each with why now, how to do it (the play’s steps or the step’s own how-to), minutes, and how you will know it is done; one unfinished ship-ready basic beside them; and three library plays that suit the stage and audience. next_steps is the plain checklist in plan order; this is the recommendation. Read-only.

done.description: Step slugs already done — the "done" list of marketinque.json. Free tier only; a project's own ticks are used instead and this is ignored.

last_done.description: Free tier: when each recurring step was last done, { "<slug>": "YYYY-MM-DD" } — the "last_done" map of marketinque.json. Steps that repeat come due again from this date. A project uses its own dates.

not_applicable.description: Step slugs the founder ruled out — the "not_applicable" list of marketinque.json. Free tier only; ignored for a project.

product_url.description: Free tier: the product’s site. It is read with the free launch report (cached for a day), so steps the site already proves are skipped and its traits are suggested. Ignored for a project, which uses its own plan.

stage.description: pre-launch · no-users (live, nobody uses it) · users-not-paying · first-customers (1–9 paying) · growing (10+ paying) · scaling. Omit to read it from the plan.

traits.description: Product traits that decide which steps apply (b2b, b2c, ai-native, dev-tool, no-code, mcp, has-integrations, eu-traffic, mobile-app); omit for the generic plan. Free tier only; a project's saved traits are used instead.

name: whats_next
title: The next working idea
